Audio Priority Bar 2.13.1 fixes **Microphones follow the output** when switching outputs from the panel or Shortcuts, and stops a microphone pick that already matches the list from staying pinned across later output switches. Coming from 2.13.0, the update installs in place, and your existing priorities and overrides are kept.

## Fixes

- With **Microphones follow the output** on, picking an output in the panel, from Shortcuts, or by connecting a paired Bluetooth device now switches to that output category's top microphone, matching Control Center ([#102](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/102)).
- Picking a microphone that is already first in the active list no longer pins it across later output switches, clearing it once an output switch makes it first again or when you reorder the active microphone list, and an input callback arriving ahead of an output callback no longer hides the category change. Thanks to @ncasdpo for reporting this ([#102](https://github.com/camguillory/Audio-Priority-Bar/pull/102)).

## Install

```bash
brew install --cask camguillory/tap/audio-priority-bar
```

Alternatively, download `AudioPriorityBar.zip` and `AudioPriorityBar.zip.sha256` below into the same folder, verify the archive, and move the app to `/Applications`:

```bash
shasum -a 256 -c AudioPriorityBar.zip.sha256
```

The release is universal for Apple silicon and Intel. It is signed with the project's own certificate, not an Apple Developer ID, and not notarized. If macOS blocks the first launch, open **System Settings > Privacy & Security** and click **Open Anyway**.

Connecting a Bluetooth device from the panel asks for Bluetooth permission, and Accessibility is optional, for the hover preview. Jabra Link monitoring may request Input Monitoring permission. Link 380 is hardware-verified. Link 390 is expected to work through the same capability check but remains unverified on hardware, and monitoring fails open when the link state cannot be read.
